name: TiXL
hint: a scene number (3), a scene name (INTRO), or an OSC address in full (/pchi/anything)

rules.source: TiXL's OscInput collects any address it is sent; a value of 1.0 is a trigger in a graph. Not yet run against TiXL: see tools/tixl/README.md
one address carrying the scene number as a float, to feed a Switch in the graph (OscInput's outputs are float). Not yet run against TiXL
one address per scene name, value 1.0, so a graph can look at the one address it cares about. Not yet run against TiXL

notes: TiXL has no fixed control addresses: you build the graph that reads them. The port is the one set on the OscInput operator.
